results.content:
A Cygnal poll released Oct. 13 found Democrats leading Republicans by 9 percentage points. An Economist/YouGov poll released Oct. 14 showed Democrats ahead by 11 points.

If those numbers hold through Election Day, Democrats could regain control of one or both chambers of Congress while putting traditionally Republican-held seats into play.

35% of U.S. adult citizens strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, while 60% disapprove, for a net job approval of -25. Over the past three Economist / YouGov Polls, Trump has averaged a -27 net approval, which is near his lowest ever received.

results.content: As the November midterm elections approach, many people in the US are feeling rather pessimistic about their futures. An Economist/YouGov survey in the US completed on October 12 asked how respondents felt about about their futures compared with ten years ago. Altogether, 23% said they were more optimistic, with 48% saying they were more pessimistic.
